topology: 2 nodes x4 H100, ncclAllReduce, P2P off (pure IB)
workload_note: `mpirun -np 8 --map-by ppr:4:node ... nccl_allreduce 8388608 20`. elems/iters are recorded for completeness, but no assertion derives a byte count from them: NCCL picks channels, protocol and chunking, so the wire volume is its decision and not the command line's — pinning Ring/Simple/1-channel moved sends from 57280 to 26880, which is the size of the gap between what we ask for and what goes out. Volume stays a golden; the assertions cover symmetry and completion health.
entity_close_note: CLOSED 2026-08-07 (MN5 job 44372679). Root cause was never a registration door: object-ops hooks are installed INSIDE an ibv_context, and UCX opens contexts through a door this provider does not interpose, so ibv_reg_dm_mr's trampoline was never installed on them while ibv_dereg_mr — a preload hook, context-independent — still fired. Hence closes naming regions nothing opened. Job 44369505 proved it: every unmatched close carried installed=NO. Fixed by installing a context on first sight through ANY door rather than only at ibv_open_device, with ibv_close_device hooked so a recycled context pointer is not mistaken for one already patched — omitting that lifecycle silently cost case 02 two of its eight ranks. Case 02 now records 504 device_memory regions that were entirely absent before, with sends unchanged at 26880. Six registration hypotheses died before one that followed the object instead of the symbol; see plans/PLAN-20260806-2320-dlvsym-interposer-not-observed.
